projects.title: Web-Based Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) Non-Compliance Detection System using YOLO Algorithm (2026)
projects.description:
Developed a **web-based PPE compliance monitoring system** that detects and records personal protective equipment violations for personnel entering a factory environment, with a compliance dashboard for reviewing violation records and tracking non-compliance.

The project began with field research through direct observation and interviews at a processing factory to understand existing safety compliance challenges and translate them into a practical software solution. I also collected CCTV footage from the factory environment and prepared the dataset through data annotation to support the development and evaluation of the detection system. **From there, the project was carried through the full cycle of product research, modeling, development, deployment, and UAT.**

projects.title: Broiler Prediction System (2025)
projects.overview: The **Broiler Prediction System** assists poultry farms in monitoring key parameters such as temperature, humidity, and ammonia level, feed consumption, mortality, etc. By leveraging IoT sensors and AI models, the system **detects potential anomalies and helps maintain optimal environmental conditions in broiler houses.**
projects.architecture: The backend connects **IoT devices, AI model, and mobile systems** in a unified architecture. Sensor data are transmitted through an **MQTT broker**, processed by the **Flask backend**, and analyzed by trained **machine learning model**. The provided API endpoint is used by mobile system.

features.text: Real-time Data Streaming via MQTT protocol
IoT Simulator for testing and development environments
Automated Machine Learning Prediction scheduled at 09:00 and 16:00 WIB
Data Preprocessing & Storage with SQL database

projects.title: Chickin App (2024-2025)
projects.overview:
**Chickin Apps** is a digital solution designed to help farmers manage their poultry farm operations more efficiently, productively, and effectively.

The platform enables farm owners to monitor daily operations and staff performance in real time, providing greater visibility and control over farm activities through its integrated features.
scope: Conducted research and development on **offline-first methodology**, then designed and implemented a **local NoSQL database** to support mobile application requirements.
Translated UI/UX designs into functional Android interfaces, maintaining consistency with design specifications.
Extended Android application capabilities through integration with an ERP system.
Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve application bugs.
Enhanced existing application features and introduced new capabilities to improve functionality and user experience.
Contributed to the development and maintenance of mobile application features across the full-stack mobile development process.

projects.title: Chickin IoT App (2024-2025)
projects.overview: **IoT Chickin App** is an Android-based application that helps farmers monitor and control poultry house environmental conditions and electrical energy usage in real time, using MQTT for communication between the application and IoT devices.
scope: Developed sensor calibration and calibration reset features.
Developed sensor error detection and notification features.
Implemented the enable/disable functionality for temperature sensors.
Fixed and resolved bugs to improve application stability and reliability.
Worked with MQTT-based real-time communication between the Android application and IoT devices.
Cross-collaboration with PM, UI/UX, QA, Automation Engineer, and Backend.

projects.title: Resik (2022)
projects.overview:
**Resik** offers a practical answer to Indonesia's waste problem. It is an application for a waste bank company that operates branches across several Indonesian cities, turning a process that normally requires a trip into something people can do from home.

Through Resik, residents can **deposit recyclable waste and manage their waste bank savings without visiting a branch in person**, making recycling a routine habit rather than an errand.

**3rd Winner** of the competition at Techfest 2022, held by HIMTI, Bina Nusantara University.
